verdict.rationale: Google Drive's OAuth model supports least-privilege scopes, notably the narrow 'drive.file' scope limiting access to only files created/opened by the app (docs-8), plus granular permission roles (docs-7, docs-25). However, there is no documentation specifically about issuing scoped credentials for an AI agent (e.g., agent-specific OAuth flows, service accounts, or workload identity federation tailored to agentic use), despite agent/ADK integration being mentioned generally (docs-4). missing for 10: agent-specific credential issuance workflow, documentation tying scoped OAuth to autonomous agent use cases, independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement in agent contexts.
